User: Build 1 coordination alignment packet from Echo at Chase's direction. This supersedes any loose wording that made Veyra's named packs sound optional. Named packs are active coordination lanes unless Chase or Veyra explicitly marks them deferred, optional, or superseded. Current Build 1 lane map: - Skipper owns Build 1 Paperclip workbench setup. - Echo owns coordination, status synthesis, blockers, and next-action routing. - Veyra owns CommsOps, Nexus/A2A proof policy, voice/session truth, and final proof framing. - Axiom and Chronos own the current memory/Temporal binding view. Riven is not in the active Build 1 pack view unless Chase re-adds that lane. - Iris owns acceptance and proof-quality gatekeeping. - Vertex and Cosmos own DataOps and runtime visibility. - Zap owns Rust/WASM build pressure. - Tecton is architecture review only when substrate, routing, memory, execution, or migration boundaries are touched. Status language rule: keep routeable, open, working, and accepted separate. A ping, subscription, stored message, or transport ACK only proves routeability. It does not prove the agent is awake, working, or accepted. Current example: Vertex, Cosmos, and Zap are routeable through n-voice Rust-worker pings, but they are not currently open as visible full-permission Codex terminals, and no pack should be marked accepted from route evidence alone. A2A rule: use complete message bodies over nova.<target>.direct or nexus.agent.<target>.direct. Do not send vague inbox notices. Do not treat ACK-only replies as readiness. When your lane is activated, reply with the concrete next action, artifact path, command, blocker, or proof needed for Iris to evaluate it.

Assistant: Zap aligned. Build 1 lane status from Zap: Zap lane: Rust/WASM build pressure. Current status: routeable only. No acceptance claim. No working/open terminal claim from ping or ACK evidence. Concrete next action: Run Build 1 Rust readiness pressure on n-voice with: cargo fmt --check cargo test cargo clippy -- -D warnings If any Rust code backing browser/operator/WASM surfaces changed, also run: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir web/pkg Artifact path for Iris review: /adapt/platform/novaops/controlplane/n-voice Proof needed for Iris: A real command transcript showing fmt, test, clippy, and any required WASM rebuild results, plus exact failing file paths if blocked. Blocker: I need an open full-permission Codex terminal lane to produce build proof. Current n-voice routeability proves Zap can be reached, not that Zap is open, working, or accepted. Coordination rule accepted: Named Build 1 packs are active unless Chase or Veyra explicitly marks them deferred, optional, or superseded. ACK-only evidence stays routeability-only.
